text:
Tara: flagging Kinetix onboarding - PM says users see intermittent slowdowns in batch summarization jobs during peak ingest windows. renewal touchpoint in 3 weeks so want to be proactive.
Omar: do we have perf traces? is it latency or OOMs?
Tara: mostly p95 latency spikes and occasional queueing on their Dedicated pool. no OOMs reported.
Ben: two likely contributors: long sequences causing KV cache thrash, and mixed request shapes hitting the same worker. recommend: 1) model partitioning by intent, 2) enable mixed-precision quant for long batches, 3) route heavy summarization to a larger context model.
Sofia: i can draft a small traffic plan. propose: summarize-intent -> redwood/pegasus-16k-q4_0, short-chat -> redwood/blitz-3b-fast. non-critical batch jobs stay on current model for comparison.
Tara: fine. can we make this safe to test? want automatic fallback if latency increases.
Omar: yes, use weighted rollout + health checks. example routing rule i'm proposing:
```json
{
  "routes": [
    {"match": "metadata.intent == 'summarize' && tokens > 1200", "model": "redwood/pegasus-16k-q4_0", "weight": 0.15},
    {"match": "metadata.intent == 'chat' || tokens <= 1200", "model": "redwood/blitz-3b-fast", "weight": 0.85}
  ],
  "health_check": {"p95_ms": 600, "error_rate_pct": 0.5},
  "fallback": "redwood/pegasus-16k-pt"
}
```
Ben: also recommend turning on KV prefix caching for session-based summarization. header: X-Enable-KV: 1. For long tail repeated context, this can cut compute by ~25%.
Sofia: i'll add synthetic workload in canary: 1.2x production traffic for 10 minutes, measure p50/p95/p99, cpu/gpu util, queue length. alert if p95 > 600ms or error_rate > 0.5%.
Tara: can we surface expected cost/quality tradeoffs? finance will want numbers before renewal call.
Ben: quick ballpark: moving summarization to peg-q4 yields ~30% compute saving on those flows versus prod baseline, but peg-16k uses bigger mem so small bump in allocation cost; net estimated infra delta roughly -12% overall given current traffic mix. quality drop should be negligible on our eval prompts. i'll post the prompt-specific delta after running evals.
Omar: schedule a 15-min sync with Kinetix tomorrow 9:30am PT for the canary walkthrough? include an ops runbook and rollback steps.
Sofia: booked and added to calendar. will record.
infra-bot: Canary rollout task created: kinetix-quant-route-canary (15%). status: awaiting approvals.
Tara: approving now. please annotate the ticket with the runbook link.
Ben: added runbook link and a small script to toggle weights via the routing API. example curl in runbook.
Sofia: noted action items: 1) enable routing policy, 2) KV header toggle in client integ, 3) synthetic load + alerting, 4) collect pre/post metrics block.
Tara: capturing customer feedback too: request telemetry for slow frames so Kinetix PM can see exact UX impact.
Omar: after canary, we'll review p95 trend and cost delta and decide on 50% rollout. if anything regresses, fallback to pegasus-16k-pt automatically.
Tara: thanks team. will summarize for renewal owner and include a short blurb on expected impact: "target p95 reduction for summarization flows: ~40-55%, expected net infra cost change: ~-10 to -15%".
Ben: i'll upload the evaluation diffs and the perf script outputs in the thread when ready.
Sofia: will post canary results here EOD tomorrow. :rocket:
